decision.best_next_data_target: cleaned halo/tree auxiliary product, not another raw halo_info column
decision.first_gate: filesystem inventory only; do not open/decompress ASDF arrays
decision.second_gate_if_present: YAML/header-only schema probe of exactly one cleaned_halo_info superslab to confirm TimeSliceRedshiftsPrev and field shapes
decision.third_gate_if_safe: only then design a bounded targeted extraction strategy

official_source_findings.cleaned_catalog_release: The cleaned halo catalog release is a self-contained data product distinct from raw off-machine halo files.
official_source_findings.loader_behavior: Requesting fields='all' includes main-progenitor information and can be slow; narrow field selection is preferable.
official_source_findings.secondary_snapshots: AbacusSummit secondary redshifts are explicitly intended to support merger-tree construction using persistent subsample PIDs.

scientific_usefulness.N_mainprog: Provides a multi-epoch L1-particle-count main-progenitor history, useful as a mass proxy only; it is not M200c.
scientific_usefulness.haloindex_mainprog: Provides the immediate main-progenitor identity used by the cleaning/tree machinery.
scientific_usefulness.sigmav3d_L2com_mainprog: Provides an internal velocity-dispersion proxy over previous timeslices.
scientific_usefulness.v_L2com_mainprog: Provides main-progenitor bulk velocity for the immediately previous snapshot.
scientific_usefulness.vcirc_max_L2com_mainprog: Provides an internal-potential/structure proxy over previous timeslices.
what_it_still_does_not_supply: radial second moments through all times

uploaded_E43.recommended_next_gate: small same-object multi-epoch dynamical summary; no whole-column ASDF scan
